title: Ballistic Armored Response Vehicles - Request for Quote
agency: HOMELAND SECURITY, DEPARTMENT OF.US CUSTOMS AND BORDER PROTECTION.ADMINISTRATION FACILITIES TRAINING CONTRACTING DIVISION
description_text: It is the intent of CBP/SOD to procure additional BATT-X units with off- road capabilities for use by SRT Operators in High Risk/High Threat operations with a ballistic protection of B7/NIJ Level IV capable of stopping .50 Ball Ammunition. In addition, this scope includes full replacement and/or repair warranty where applicable and the customer support necessary.
